## Change

Describe the problem and resulting change. Link the task or external board item.

## Verification

List the commands/checks actually run and their results. State any unverified work. For document changes, inspect local links and whether a corresponding PDF needs regeneration.

## Documentation and AI Assistance

Identify affected reports, evidence, or AI-use records. Keep authorship and human validation factual; do not claim reviewer approval before it happens.

## Review

Name the actual reviewer when assigned. Team merge and branch rules are pending agreement.
